title: 🔐 Mission — Lockout System
subtitle: Build a 3-attempt PIN lockout using a while loop.
instructions: This is a build-it-yourself mission — there are no blanks to fill in. Rebuild the lockout system from your workbook's worked example, using CORRECT_PIN below.
starterCode:
# LOCKOUT SYSTEM - Morpheus Security Systems
# Mission: build a 3-attempt PIN lockout system

attempts = 0
CORRECT_PIN = "1234"

# Your mission: write the while loop here
# It should:
#   - Keep asking for a PIN while attempts is less than 3
#   - Grant access and stop asking if the PIN is correct
#   - Otherwise, count the attempt and tell the user how many tries are left
#   - Print "Account LOCKED" if all 3 attempts are used without success

# HINT: this is the same structure your teacher modelled on the whiteboard
# and that's copied into your workbook — rebuild it here from memory,
# checking your workbook only if you get stuck.
hints: Start with while attempts < 3: — the loop keeps going as long as there are attempts left.
Inside the loop: ask for a PIN, then check it with if/else, just like your Week 5 login check.
If the PIN is correct: print a success message and use break to stop the loop immediately.
If the PIN is wrong: add 1 to attempts and print how many tries are left (3 - attempts).
After the loop, check if attempts == 3 to print the lockout message.

codeChecks.message: Use a while loop that repeats while attempts is less than 3.
Compare the entered PIN against CORRECT_PIN.
Add 1 to attempts each time the PIN is wrong.
Use break to stop the loop once access is granted.

successMessage: Your lockout system works. Test all three paths: correct on try 1, correct after some failures, and a full lockout after 3 failures. Ready for Silver? Let the user set their own PIN first. Ready for Gold? Add a countdown message and a friendlier lockout message.
